title: The Last Vector Again
premise: Lior Montrose, a clone of a murdered detective, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits, hiding from the corporate syndicate that killed his original. When he answers a distress beacon broadcasting in a dead language, he finds a cryoship holding two sealed populations: the descendants of the syndicate's founders and the laborers they erased from history. The ship's failing AI forces him to choose which half wakes first, and the syndicate arrives to make that choice for him. Lior chooses neither half alone—he wakes them together, exposes the syndicate's founding crime using his original's recovered case files, and finally claims a belonging he never thought a copy could have.
about_author: Isandro Okonkwo is a former maritime radio operator who turned to science fiction after a decade spent listening to voices in the dark. He writes about people who inherit other people's unfinished business.

chapters.title: Dead Frequency
chapters.summary: POV Lior. Hauling scrap through the Verge, Lior intercepts a distress signal in a language extinct since the Collapse—his original's specialty. Against twelve years of survival instinct, he follows it to a derelict cryoship drifting in a contested orbit. Emotional beat: reluctant curiosity cracking open old grief, as the signal seems addressed to his original by name.

chapters.title: Two Doors
chapters.summary: POV Lior. Aboard the ship, its dying AI reveals two cryo-banks: founders' descendants and the erased laborer caste, with power for only one wake cycle. Syndicate scouts arrive hunting the signal, forcing Lior to hide among the frozen. Emotional beat: dread hardening into resolve as he realizes the choice mirrors the murder case he inherited.

chapters.title: The Inheritance Clause
chapters.summary: POV alternating Lior and Vess, a syndicate auditor ordered to erase the ship. Lior decrypts his original's hidden case files inside the AI, proving the founders' crime; Vess, sent to kill him, reads the evidence instead. Emotional beat: climax—the syndicate board orders both banks vented, and Lior and Vess betray their programming together.

chapters.title: Everyone Wakes
chapters.summary: POV Lior. Rigging the reactor to power both banks at lethal cost, Lior broadcasts the case files fleet-wide while the syndicate burns his cargo hauler around him. Both populations wake to the truth; the crew mutinies against the board. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution—justice outside the law, and a clone who finally belongs to no one's shadow but his own.
